srinivasa ramanujans contributions series part 13 ramanujans theta functions and mock theta functions theta functions represent one of the most central themes running throughout srinivasa ramanujans mathematical work from his earliest notebooks compiled around 1903 to his final letter to gh hardy written just months before his death in 1920 ramanujan explored theta functions with extraordinary depth and originality his work falls naturally into two parts classical theta functions where he developed extensive identities and transformations building on the foundations of jacobi and others and mock theta functions a revolutionary concept he introduced in his last letter to hardy that remained mysterious for nearly a century until sander zwegers breakthrough in 2002 connected them to harmonic weak maass forms ramanujans classical theta functions ramanujan defined his primary theta functions using the twovariable general theta function fab n ann12 bnn12 for ab 1 this general form encompasses three special functions that appear throughout his work q fqq n qn q fqq n0 qnn12 and fq fqq n 1n qn3n12 qq where aq k1 1aqk1 is the qpochhammer symbol additionally ramanujan extensively used a fourth function q qq k0 1q2k1 which while not technically a theta function in the classical sense plays a fundamental role in theta function theory and appears prominently in his work on class invariants and modular equations these theta functions can also be expressed using infinite products from jacobis triple product identity n qnzn qzq qzq qq ramanujan obtained the product representation fab aab bab abab applying this to the special cases gives q qq qq q qq qq and the pentagonal number theorem fq qq development in the notebooks ramanujans three main notebooks compiled between approximately 1903 and 1914 contain 39 sections devoted to theta functions encompassing 135 theorems corollaries and examples chapter 16 of his second notebook alone contains 72 entries on theta functions making it one of the most comprehensive treatments of the subject by any single mathematician the entries range from fundamental identities like q q 16qq entry 166 in berndts edition to sophisticated transformation formulas relating theta functions at different arguments many of these identities were unknown before ramanujan and remain central to modern work in partition theory number theory and mathematical physics for example on page 321 of his second notebook ramanujan recorded the remarkable identity 1 6n1 n3 qn1qn 1fq13 fq43q53 qfq23q73 qfq13q83 where n3 denotes the legendre symbol this identity connects a lambert series a sum involving divisor functions with products of theta functions at fractional arguments demonstrating ramanujans ability to relate disparate areas of analysis connections to partition theory theta functions serve as generating functions for various partition problems the function q n qn generates partitions with parts differing by at least 2 while q n0 qnn12 generates partitions into distinct parts the pentagonal number theorem fq qq n 1n qn3n12 connects partition generating functions to a remarkable bilateral series involving pentagonal numbers ramanujan discovered numerous identities connecting these partition interpretations for instance the rogersramanujan identities which ramanujan rediscovered independently state that gq n0 qnqqn 1qqqq and hq n0 qnnqqn 1qqqq these can be expressed as partition identities the number of partitions of n into parts differing by at least 2 equals the number of partitions into parts congruent to 1 or 4 mod 5 theta function transformations ramanujan discovered extensive transformation formulas for theta functions these include modular transformations how theta functions behave under 1 multiplication formulas relating q to qn and addition formulas expressing products like qq in terms of single theta functions one particularly useful transformation recorded on page 294 of his second notebook relates the functions gn and gn class invariants defined using q gn8 gn8 212 gn gn and gn gn 2gn8 gn8 these allow computation of class invariants which are algebraic numbers fundamental to ramanujans series for 1 differential equations for theta functions ramanujan discovered differential equations satisfied by theta functions for the three primary functions and f he found relationships involving their derivatives with respect to q or logq2i these differential equations connect theta functions to modular forms and eisenstein series providing a bridge between qseries and the theory of differential equations for example the logarithmic derivative ddqlog q can be expressed as a lambert series n1 nqn1qn which in turn relates to divisor functions and eisenstein series these connections allowed ramanujan to prove identities involving sums of divisors using theta function theory applications to modular equations and elliptic functions theta functions are intimately connected to elliptic functions through the relationship kk 2q where kk is the complete elliptic integral of the first kind k is the modulus and q expkk with k k1k this connection allowed ramanujan to use theta function identities to derive modular equationsalgebraic relations between k and when nkk ll for some integer n ramanujan recorded hundreds of modular equations in his notebooks more than any other mathematician has ever discovered many of these were derived using theta function identities for example the degree3 modular equation relating k and can be written as 14 1114 1 and this can be proved using transformation properties of q and q the 1920 letter and mock theta functions on january 12 1920 just three months before his death at age 32 ramanujan wrote his final letter to hardy from india the letter contained one of the most mysterious and profound discoveries in mathematics the introduction of mock theta functions ramanujan wrote i am extremely sorry for not writing you a single letter up to now i discovered very interesting functions recently which i call mock functions unlike the false functions studied partially by prof rogers in his interesting paperthey enter into mathematics as beautifully as the ordinary theta functions i am sending you with this letter some examples the letter contained 17 explicit examples of mock theta functions divided into four groups based on their order 3 5 7 and 10 ramanujan provided no formal definition of what constitutes a mock theta function or what order means making this one of the most enigmatic communications in mathematical history ramanujans description of mock theta functions in his letter ramanujan explained his motivation through the behavior of functions at their singularities for ordinary theta functions like gq n0 qnqqn when q et with t 0 the asymptotic form closes neatly in an exponential form specifically functions like ge can be evaluated exactly and yield algebraic numbers however ramanujan discovered functions where this closure fails he asked suppose there is a function in the eulerian form and suppose that all or an infinity of points q e2ihk are exponential singularities and also suppose that at these points the asymptotic form closes as neatly as in the cases of ordinary theta functions the question is is the function the sum of two functions one of which is an ordinary function and the other a trivial function which is o1 at all the points when it is not so i call the function a mock function in other words mock theta functions mimic the behavior of modular forms which ramanujan called theta functions in having nice asymptotic properties at roots of unity but they cannot be expressed as a sum of a modular form and a simple bounded function this makes them genuinely new objects distinct from classical modular forms the 17 examples orders 3 5 7 and 10 third order 3 functions fq n0 qnqqn q n0 qnqqn q n1 qnqqn watson later discovered a fourth thirdorder function q n0 qnqqnqqn fifth order 10 functions fq n0 qnqqn fq n0 qnnqqn q n0 qnqqn q n0 qn1qqn q n0 qnn12qqn q n0 qn1n22qqn and four more denoted f f with similar the lost notebook george andrews discovered ramanujans lost notebook in 1976 at trinity college cambridge among papers of gn watson this 138page manuscript written during the last year of ramanujans life 19191920 contains 16 additional mock theta functions that ramanujan never explicitly identified as such but which clearly belong to the same family most notably the lost notebook contains seven sixthorder mock theta functions q n0 1n qnqqnqq2n q n0 1n qn1qqnqq2n1 q n0 qnn12qqnqqn1 q n0 qn1n22qqnqqn1 q n0 1n qn qqnqqn and two more denoted and andrews and dean hickerson proved many identities relating these sixthorder functions in their landmark 1991 paper ramanujans lost notebook vii the sixth order mock theta functions published in advances in mathematics additionally younseo choi discovered and analyzed several eighth and tenth order mock theta functions in the lost notebook in papers from 19992000 watsons verification efforts 19361937 gn watson devoted significant effort to proving ramanujans assertions about mock theta functions in his papers the final problem an account of the mock theta functions journal of the london mathematical society 1936 and subsequent works adopted a 6monthold kitten whos severely stressed and struggling to adjust looking for advice before adopting my partner and i were very intentional about the process we spoke with several people who were rehoming kittens because we travel for work occasionally and any cat we adopt would eventually need to be comfortable with a slow carefully introduced traveling lifestyle we were very upfront that this would be an essential part of the cats life and specifically asked about personality traits like confidence curiosity and how the kitten handled change or new environments we ultimately adopted a 6monthold british longhair kitten six days ago and shes been having an extremely difficult time adjusting since coming home she initially refused to eat or drink and barely peed or pooped she spends almost all of her time hiding we were advised not to force interaction food or unnecessary handling as that could significantly increase her stress so weve been giving her space to make her space more comfortable we set it up as follows feliway diffuser flat food bowl to avoid whisker exhaustion stainless steel water fountain a bowl with still water as a secondary option an uncovered litter box that is far away from her food area and plenty of areas to hide in after almost three days of her not eating or drinking at all we became very concerned and called the emergency vet they had us bring her in immediately due to the risk of dehydration thankfully all tests came back normal she was given fluids to help prevent constipation and prescribed an appetite stimulant that we apply to her ear at first she would tolerate being picked up briefly we only did this twice to apply the appetite medication as instructed by the vet however over the past couple of days she has started to panic during these moments and has become defensive and mildly aggressive so we have decided to pause her medication for now this change in behaviour has been alarming and seems to coincide with her rising stress levels one positive sign is that she is now eating drinking and using the litter box but only when were not in the room or when were asleep she even goes ahead and explores the room when no one is around sometimes breaking things and using cables to play but as soon as she hears us she retreats back into hiding behind the bed or under the closet despite the small improvements were still very worried the vet said she appears to be in a shutdown state caused by extreme stress likely from being separated from her previous family she also mentioned that its unusual for a cat from a healthy family background to remain in this state for so long and warned that if not improved it could become dangerous since cats can develop serious illnesses when stress or depression persists we have tried using toys and treats to encourage her to come out but her fear seems greater than her food motivation which makes it very difficult for context we previously adopted a scottish fold kitten at around the same age and he adjusted within about three days because of that comparison and what the vet explained were starting to worry that this kitten may never fully adjust what makes this more confusing is that during her emergency clinic visit the staff noted that she was surprisingly social calm and friendly with them the vet even said she believed the kitten would do well with travel training in the future and was surprised by how fearful she is at home we also followed up with her previous owner who now changed her original answer and mentioned that the kitten would hide for days when visiting her parents house something we were not initially aware of but maintains that in her home she used to be very social hearing this we agreed that if the kitten does not show signs of improvement and continues to be constantly stressed out we might have to return her to her previous owner which would sadden us greatly weve been watching and studying jackson galaxys videos and plan to begin a slow structured desensitization and counterconditioning process once shes more stable using a very gradual and pressurefree approach that being said our main questions now are once she feels safe with us is it realistic to aim to train her to be comfortable with a harness and eventually traveling or is this level of stress a sign of her permanent personality meaning we should abandon the idea of traveling with her entirely is this extreme fear simply part of the adjustment period or does it suggest a deeper incompatibility with change and new environments we truly want to do whats best for her and dont want to force her into a lifestyle that would make her unhappy and this could inform us on how to proceed with her advice from anyone who has experienced something similar or has worked with stressed kittens would be incredibly valuable

why elriel hits harder than any other ship no other ship ive come across in the last few years of my romantasy obsession has ever come close to keeping me in a chokehold the way elriel does ive been asking myself why for a long time now and i think i finally have the answer mutual respect and trust they exist in a world society that does not support their romance and the only way they can get through that is by navigating it together they have to trust the other person that its safe to cross the line physically trust them with keeping the secret and trust them to maintain affection when they cant openly or regularly encourage that affection around others its the healthiest and most wholesome way to build a relationship and truly solidifies that friendship aspect which i think is crucial for a strong partnership the conflicts are external lately we see a ton of stories that are enemies to lovers they have to grapple with the confusion of who they thought someone was vs who they actually are its a very complex inner battle that is frankly exhausting to read sometimes and very overdone in contrast elriel is a friends to lovers storyline there is no question about the fact that they have feelings for each other or even why they have those feelings they know the other person is good and their connection only strengthens over time acotar is not a sadtragic series we know the ending will be happy and therefore we know it will work out in the end there is a sense of safety in that knowledge which allows us to spend more time cheering for their success and joy than wondering whether it will work out the characters dont hit below the belt consider how cassian used the phrase shackled and how badly that hurt nestas already fragile selfimage or how rhys belittled and embarrased feyre while utm which was a very vulnerable time for her or how feyre kept comparing rhys to tamlin which he desperately always tries never to be all of those things hurt their partners ego and selfworth in a way that they have to work really hard to overcome in contrast azriel was not a jerk when he told elain this was a mistake she already knows why he isnt around much lately aka she knows hes deeply into her which means she will interpret that comment to mean hes not ready to face his feelings not that there is anything wrong with herself as a person elain and azriel dont deeply hurt each other the way many enemies to lovers pairings do they do not have to reconcile their partners insensitivity with their own feelings for them and i love that making the most of every moment together given that elriel is essentially forbidden they have to make the most of every stolen moment they get together you either saydo what you mean with your whole heart or it fails we repeatedly see how elain and azriel dont waste their moments with small talk or excessive drinking or taunts they either speak about the things they care about or they simply enjoy each others presence we see them have some communication failure in the bc yes but its mostly due to things being left unsaid rather than things being said hurtfully and i prefer this in my love stories i also love the effort behind finding creative unsuspecting ways to enjoy time together elain and azriel use the garden as their space and i wouldnt be shocked if the kitchen becomes one too im excited to see all of the other creative ways they find time together the relief of their ability to be together is palpable unlike other couples that are spend time together regularly and use it to do a variety of things work arguing training whatever couples like elriel have brief limited moments we see their relationship progress through those quick snippets of time short conversations and small physical interactions this makes the payoff of their success immensely satisfying and cathartic when we finally get to see them wholly unrestrained with long amounts of time together it shows us who they truly are in a free and relaxed space its exciting and were all enjoying that successful high together it also leaves room for additional storyline and surprises because now we have a chance to really explore who they are as an established couple its almost like an entirely new story which means that not only will we get to see how they become a couple in their book but well also get to see them be a couple in the background of future books which is inherently very different than feysand or nessian elriel is the gift that keeps on giving

enemies who rarely miss a shot along with troops spawning everywhere the game looks great visually but the level design feels very linear almost like a generic corridor shooter however the narrative takedowns distractions and sabotage although a fully stealth based approach can still feel quite challenging the game takes place across vast african desert landscapes offering levels that feature nature play for babies and toddlers simple ways to start early nature play is not just for older children who can run climb and explore independently babies and toddlers benefit deeply from being outdoors often more than we realise fresh air natural movement changing sounds textures and light all support early development in ways indoor spaces cannot fully replicate getting very young children outside does not need to be complicated risky or timeconsuming it starts with understanding why outdoor experiences matter and how small everyday moments can become powerful learning opportunities why nature play matters so early babies are born ready to explore from the very beginning they learn through movement touch sound and sight outdoors naturally provides richer sensory experiences than most indoor environments nature play supports physical development through crawling rolling standing and walking brain development through movement and sensory input balance and coordination through uneven ground and natural surfaces curiosity and focus through realworld sights and sounds emotional wellbeing through calm open spaces the earlier babies become comfortable outdoors the more confident they tend to be as toddlers and young children common worries about taking babies outside many adults hesitate to take babies outdoors regularly these concerns are understandable but often manageable common worrya more helpful way to think about it getting dirtydirt is part of sensory learning and can be washed off falling oversmall falls help babies learn balance and body control putting things in the mouthsupervision and safe spaces reduce real risk cold or wet weatherproper clothing makes outdoor play possible yearround lack of timeshort outdoor moments still count nature play does not need to be perfect to be beneficial the problem with too much indoor time many babies spend large parts of the day being moved from one place to another rather than moving themselves time in cots prams car seats and highchairs can limit opportunities to crawl stretch twist and explore limited movement can affect muscle strength balance coordination body awareness attention and focus later on outdoor spaces naturally invite movement even a short walk where a toddler is allowed to walk slowly stop and explore provides far more learning than being rushed along in a pram what babies and toddlers learn outdoors nature play supports learning without needing structured activities or instructions area of developmentoutdoor experiences that help movementcrawling on grass walking on uneven ground sensory learningwind sunlight water leaves sounds languagetalking about what is seen heard and felt problemsolvingnavigating slopes steps and obstacles emotional regulationcalm rhythms of nature the outdoors offers learning that happens naturally without planning worksheets or toys weather is part of the experience outdoor play does not need perfect weather different conditions offer different learning opportunities cool air feels different on skin wind carries sounds and smells rain creates puddles and reflections seasonal changes bring new colours and textures the key is appropriate clothing so curiosity is not interrupted by discomfort simple nature play ideas for babies and toddlers nature play does not require expensive equipment or permanent installations for babies lay a blanket outside and look at the sky listen to birds wind and distant sounds let babies touch grass leaves or smooth stones hold babies near plants so they can smell and feel textures for crawlers create short crawling paths using grass mats and tunnels place mirrors at low heights outdoors roll balls of different sizes and watch how they move explore shallow water with supervision for toddlers set up simple obstacle paths using logs hoops or planks push rideon toys or doll pushchairs jump spin dance and twirl to music outside scoop pour and splash with water pots and sponges walk slowly and stop often to observe surroundings the most important part is adult attention talking noticing and responding to what fascinates the child nature is the best sensory resource nature already offers endless materials leaves sticks pebbles and mud water puddles and streams shadows light and movement animals insects and people passing by these experiences help babies make sense of the world using their whole body not just their eyes things to reflect on consider these simple questions when thinking about outdoor time questionwhy it matters how much time is spent outdoors each dayeven small increases help can indoor routines move outsidesensory play works well outdoors are there barriers that can be adjustedclothing timing expectations are walks slow and exploratorytoddlers learn through stopping is there a safe natural surface availablegrass sand or earth support movement small changes often make the biggest difference a simple takeaway nature play for babies and toddlers is not about structured lessons or pushing skills early it is about allowing time space and freedom to explore the real world being outdoors supports movement curiosity language confidence and calm a short daily outdoor moment can shape how children relate to nature for years to come start where you are use what you have let nature do the rest

while youre stuck googling romantic gestures at 2am heres what nobody tells you romance isnt about grand gestures or copying some movie scene its a skill you can actually learn ive spent months digging into relationship psychology reading everything from attachment theory research to interviews with therapists and yeah talking to a lot of women about what actually makes them feel seen and desired turns out most guys are getting this wrong in the exact same ways the real kicker society never taught us this shit we got action movies and sports but no one sat us down and explained how emotional attunement works or why thoughtfulness hits different than expensive gifts but heres the good news once you understand the mechanics behind what makes someone feel romanced it becomes way easier 1 stop performing romance start paying attention most guys think romance is about doing big things nope romance is about noticing small things women feel most romanced when they realize youve been paying attention to details they didnt even know they shared she mentioned she loves rainy mornings three months ago text her a cozy playlist when it rains she gets stressed on tuesdays because of work meetings leave her favorite snack somewhere shell find it tuesday morning this is backed by research in relationship psychology dr john gottmans work shows that successful relationships are built on bids for connection those tiny moments where someone shares something and you actually respond romance isnt the gesture itself its proving i see you i remember you you matter to me start keeping mental notes not in a creepy spreadsheet way but genuinely listen when she talks women notice when you remember 2 master the art of anticipation real romance creates anticipation not mystery with her hair while youre watching tv kiss her forehead randomly pull her in for a hug from behind while shes cooking rest your hand on her lower back when youre in public these microtouches throughout the day create way more romantic tension than one big gesture its the difference between he wants something from me and he cant help but touch me because hes drawn to me 4 create rituals that are just yours shared rituals build intimacy like nothing else esther perel talks about this in her relationship work these dont have to be elaborate could be sunday morning coffee in bed together no phones a specific song thats your song that you play randomly a weekly walk where you both share one thing that happened that week cooking a specific meal together every month the key is consistency romance isnt just spontaneity its also showing up reliably in small ways that say this matters to me 5 write it down yes really texting is easy handwritten notes hit different theres actual psychology behind this the physical act of writing something by hand creates more emotional weight for both writer and receiver you dont need to be shakespeare just genuine thought about you when i saw this today with a photo of something shed appreciate a sticky note on the bathroom mirror before she wakes up a short letter explaining specifically what you love about her not generic stuff specific observations the book the 5 love languages by gary chapman is clutch here this thing has sold over 20 million copies and won multiple awards because it breaks down exactly how different people receive love some people need words others need actions some need touch figure out her language and speak it insanely good read thatll make you question everything you thought you knew about showing affection chapman is a relationship counselor with decades of research and this book basically gives you the cheat codes 6 plan experiences not just dates dinner is fine dinner is safe but guys women find romantic and guys they dont romantic guys are deeply curious about their partners inner world ask deeper questions what made you feel most alive this week if you could change one thing actually helpful here for building better habits around thoughtfulness its a selfcare app that helps you track patterns and set reminders to do the small things that matter sounds corny but consistency is what separates romantic guys from guys who have one good idea every six months 9 make her laugh then make her feel safe humor and security are the ultimate romantic combo women are drawn to guys who can make them laugh but romance happens when they feel safe enough to be vulnerable this means dont use humor to deflect serious conversations be playful but know when to shift to the deepest romantic bonds come from being a secure base for your partner you can be fun and light but also solid and dependable 10 understand that romance is a practice not a personality heres the level design and rhythm in stealth games and why i dislike outdoor levels in my opinion stealth games live and die by their level design taking the closest adjacent genre which is action games tps fps cag etc they can get away with mediocre level design as long as theres a decent variety of enemies stealth games however can mostly use generic human enemies and with the right placement which heavily depends on level design and a good ai you get games like splinter cell thief mgs dishonored etc sure you can mix it up by adding stuff like cameras lasers and minipuzzles but thats what id consider a cherry on top theres a reason peoples highlights from stealth games are almost always levels not specific mechanics or enemies the bank from chaos theory sapienza from nuhitman and of course the manor from dishonored 2 thats because level design is the most valuable tool in contextualizing mechanics in a stealth game after all navigation is at the core of stealth what routes you should take how you avoid enemies and how to use your environment to your advantage with the tools you have take nuhitmans mechanics and put them in the thief reboot will that automatically make it a good game obviously no you can change everything about the thief reboot but nothing will make it good unless you start designing good dense levels to make use of these mechanics now that ive established why i think level design is king in stealth games let me present my main point of discussion rhythm stealth is probably my favorite genre so when someone asks me to recommend something my mind always jumps to mgs or hitman for example but sometimes im met with a common complaint i hate the feeling of tension in stealth games and thats a fair point because tension is the primary emotion stealth should give but perfecting it is an art in itself a lot of my favorite stealth games have a great rhythm to their stealth between tension and relief that makes methodically stealthing through a level extremely satisfying the levels usually start you in a position of advantage outside the place youre supposed to infiltrate or inside the premises but from the back where few guards are stationed if at all as you make your way inside a level there are always places where you can get a moment of respite take a breather and get ready for the next room all the while the difficulty is escalating steadily as you get closer and closer to your objective this is the right amount of tension in my opinion and its easier to accomplish in indoor levels which takes me to my next and final point indoor levels lend themselves well to stealth games first of all theyre just much cooler to me stealth is usually required because youre in a place youre not supposed to be in and these places can be cool places that you might not have entered in real life or only seen what visitors are allowed to see but now youre exploring them thoroughly take the bank mission as a perfect example of that or the huge ship in death on the mississippi from blood money these places are just way cooler than the typical outdoor levels in games like outposts villages or military bases there are some cool outdoor levels but by and large i think indoor spaces are cooler you might think that i dislike nuhitman levels in that case but actually no outdoor levels in these games usually contain a lot of indoor spaces and the fact that hitman is a social stealth game helps make outdoor exploration fun because you dont have to be on your guard 247 and thats the biggest reason why indoor levels feel better to me unlike a game like mgsv where a lot of levels are just outposts with few if any indoor spaces this creates constant tension that results in a lack of rhythm the reason is simple youre almost constantly exposed in these spaces there arent a lot of walls or rooms where you can take a break you can be seen from all angles and you can be seen by a guard you didnt even know existed im not saying you cant create a good rhythm in outdoor spaces but its much harder and there are few i actually enjoy ground zeroes as opposed to indoor levels where due to their closed and compact nature make it easier to guide the player through them and provide natural points where tension releases the outdoor levels i usually enjoy are the ones where exploring the open outdoor space is safe but entering buildings and certain premises is not or where the outdoor space is dense with various obstacles levels like hells kitchen in deus ex or the murder of crows in blood money im not bashing any game in particular here i even love mgsv because there are levels like lufwa valley where stealth has a good rhythm to it i just dislike outpostsvillagesopen field level design that you see in a lot of stealth games or games that should ai make decisions or clarify the decision space instead should ai make decisions or should it clarify the space before a decision lately ive been noticing something that keeps bothering me in some situations getting more information doesnt actually lead to better decisions it just increases cognitive load hesitation and fear of making the wrong call this shows up especially in areas like medicine law complex business relationships ethically risky decisions most ai systems are implicitly framed like this tell me the situation and ill tell you what to do but in real life the problem often isnt that we dont know what to do the problem is that we cant clearly see why the decision is so hard ive been exploring an alternative approach ai that does not make decisions does not give advice and does not tell you which option to pick but instead maps the uncertainty risks and tradeoffs before the decision so the system doesnt say do x this information is critical this is the right path it only makes visible why this decision is difficult what risks are actually in play what kinds of costs are being carried where the core tension really sits whats interesting is this the decision still belongs to the human but the mental burden drops noticeably im genuinely curious what others think is ai not making a decision a weakness or is that restraint actually necessary in highstakes domains does a concept like decisionpreparatory ai make sense as its own category would love to hear thoughts from people whove wrestled with similar problems

understood that hh is more of a musical than a traditional character driven show i was prepared for the fact that character development wouldnt always be fully explored i was mostly okay with many character arcs being cut short and yes i was even okay with lutes arc or lack thereof given the format and pacing the show had already established what truly made season two of hh a breaking point for me was how charlie was handled in season one i personally found characters like alastor lucifer and vox to be the most entertaining but charlie was the one who truly stood out part of that is probably because i relate to her but its also because she felt genuine when we first meet charlie shes afraid of confrontation even though shes more powerful than most sinners she doesnt wield that power easily because she isnt naturally confrontational thats why her court scene with sera was such a powerful moment sera is a higherranking more powerful being yet charlie still stands up to her cause she cares about angle and her friends that scene made charlie feel real shes usually nonconfrontational often lacking confidence and presents herself with a cheerful optimistic look but there is a line when crossed she can get angry and when that happens she becomes confrontational and even aggressive that gave her weight as a character she wasnt just an optimistic cheerleader she is someone with wight and that why i absolutely loved her however season two completely undermined that its not that her arc felt incomplete or that she was acting out of character the problem is that in season two charlie didnt feel like a character at all she felt like a plot device she doesnt act the way she does because the writers are exploring her personality or pushing her character forward she acts that way because the plot needs her to move from scene a to scene b or because some event needs to happen what makes this especially frustrating is that her actions are rarely given meaningful justification yes the show points to voxs ragebaiting as the reason behind her behavior but that explanation isnt enough charlie is willing to ignore angel someone she deeply cares about and whose wellbeing is central to her identity as a compassionate character because of ragebaiting that choice doesnt feel justified and worse it carries no real consequences even by the end of the season charlie hasnt meaningfully changed or grown as a result of her actions in fact it feels like she could have been removed from the season entirely and the story wouldnt have changed much there were so many alternative paths the show could have taken she could have tried to convince the other overlords to side with her or used alastors radio station to rally the sinners of hell to her cause vox is an intelligent and powerful villain so the hero charlie didnt need to be written as incompetent in order for voxs plane to work thats ultimately why season two failed for me charlie went from being a character with emotional weight to a tool used to move the story forward and losing that depth made the entire her feel hollow in season two charlie ultimately felt like a waste of time every moment she was on screen felt like it could have been used more effectively elsewhere given how hard the show tries to save time and work within its already limited runtime its difficult to overlook the fact that the main character is the one whose screen time feels the least purposeful instead of driving the story forward or deepening her character charlies scenes often stall the narrative when a show is on top of that she doesnt play an instrumental role in driving the storyline forward this season forced me to confront the fact that the show feels light in a way that isnt satisfying the characters dont feel grounded in reality and their actions dont seem to carry real consequences when that happens the emotional weight disappears and without that weight the story loses its impact another issue i had with the show is that many of its characters feel surface level and yes i understand that with a short runtime character arcs cant always be fully explored however hh is supposed to be a story about redemption and found family at some point there needs to be space for deeper moments scenes where the characters and their relationships are shown with real depth and care without those moments the themes the show is built on start to feel more like ideas than actual experiences ironically even after two seasons of hh my understanding of the characters comes more from the comics that were released years before the show than from the show itself the comic a day in the afterlife does an excellent job of portraying alastors twisted morality in the scene where he kills a butcher who was being rude to someone also it cleverly shows that he wants to be feared yet at the same time doesnt want to be so terrifying that people avoid him entirely he craves attention and control but not complete isolation that contradiction makes him a genuinely fascinating character and its conveyed with far more clarity in the comic than in the show and the comics arent even that longtheyre less than twenty pages yet within that short span they manage to communicate who alastor truly is far more effectively than the show does for a whole two seasons the same problem applies to the relationship between angel and charlie in the comic their bond is communicated in a subtle but lasting way its clear that charlie means a great deal to angel in the show however that dynamic barely comes across if at all i understand that the season only has eight episodes and the creators are really trying to fit in everything they could within a limited runtime so i accept that not every detail could be shown that said this is a show about redemption whether we like it or not redemption requires meaningful character interactions those moments arent optional theyre essential in season two the problem with charlies writing cant be blamed on runtime constraints this wasnt a limitation it was a choice charlie isnt treated as a character shes treated as a plot device a placeholder used to move events along and that realization is what finally broke my investment in the show my final thoughts i want to make it clear that watching hb genuinely helped me during a difficult period in my life when i was struggling with both my job and personal life ive never wanted a show to be good as badly as i wanted hb and hh to be normally when i lose interest in a show i simply stop watching and move on but hb was special to me and i related to the characters in a way no other show ever had so even when there were signs that the direction was going somewhere i didnt expect i kept trying to convince myself that it would all make sense in the end i dont think either show is bad but to me they no longer feel like stories grounded in real life the characters now feel surface level and i no longer find them as relatable or authentic as i did in hb season one and thats why ive decided not to continue watching future seasons of hb and hh i have no doubt theyll continue to be fun and entertaining and im genuinely glad theyve found success i completely understand why people love these shows and i respect that i also want to acknowledge how meaningful these shows have been for lgbtq representation thats something i truly admire and appreciate this is kind of sad for me personally ive been a fan for years and being part of the fandom was a first for me i hope both series continue to thrive in the future and i hope no one takes this as an attempt to spread hate its simply a reflection of how a show that once meant a great deal to me no longer connects in the same way

spent 8 months trying to crack faceless content and heres what actually moved the needle ive been lurking here forever and figured id finally share whats been working since i see a lot of people asking about making money without showing their face online backstory i work a boring desk job doing data entry for a logistics company pay is fine but after rent car payment and groceries in this economy theres basically nothing left im also deeply introverted and the thought of being on camera makes me want to crawl into a hole tried the whole just get comfortable on camera thing for like 2 months and hated every second deleted all those videos so last year around march i started exploring faceless content the idea was simple build social accounts that dont require me to be the face of anything started with pinterest because everyone said it was easy passive traffic made like 47 pins over 3 weeks got maybe 200 views total gave up then tried those motivation quote pages on instagram you know the ones with the sunset backgrounds and generic text made one post a day for 6 weeks gained 89 followers most were bots felt like i was screaming into the void around june i pivoted to trying stock photo accounts the idea was curating aesthetic stock photos for specific niches and building a following that way problem was everyone else had the same idea and the photos looked samey couldnt differentiate heres where things shifted i stumbled into the whole ai image generation space when a friend showed me some stuff he made with midjourney spent a few weeks learning prompts made some cool art but couldnt figure out how to monetize it because the style kept changing and nothing looked cohesive enough for a brand the actual breakthrough came when i discovered you could create consistent characters like the same person in different scenarios and outfits this was around august i experimented with a few different tools runway for some video stuff tried leonardo for a bit played around with apob for the character consistency stuff and eventually landed on a workflow that let me create what looked like a real lifestyle blogger without being one i built out a character 28 year old woman kind of that cozy minimalist aesthetic took me probably 15 hours over two weeks to figure out the right look and vibe then started posting her content to instagram coffee shop moments apartment organization morning routines that kind of thing first month was brutal like 12 followers brutal almost quit again but i kept posting 5 times a week minimum started studying what performed realized the day in my life style carousel posts got way more saves than single images started adding more lifestyle context meal prep shots desk setups skincare routines by october i hit 2400 followers still not huge but the engagement rate was actually decent around 47 which apparently is above average started getting dms from small brands asking about collaborations first paid collab was 75 for three posts featuring a candle company i almost cried not because of the money but because something actually worked for once fast forward to now and the account is at around 11k followers ive done maybe 15 paid collabs ranging from 50 to 300 depending on deliverables total earnings since august roughly 2100 thats across 8 months so it averages to like 260month which isnt life changing but its real money that didnt exist before the time investment now is maybe 6 hours a week batch create content on sundays schedule posts respond to dms and comments throughout the week way more manageable than when i was trying to film myself some things i learned consistency of the character matters way more than i thought early on i was sloppy about it and people noticed something was off even if they couldnt articulate what had to restart twice the aesthetic has to be specific generic pretty girl content doesnt work because theres a million of those the cozy minimalist angle gave me a lane niche brands are way more responsive than big ones ive had zero luck pitching to companies with over 100k followers but small candle makers stationery shops and indie skincare brands actually read their dms you still need to understand content strategy the ai stuff just removes the being on camera barrier you still need to know what makes people stop scrolling what hooks work what times to post etc also had one scary moment where someone accused the account of being fake in the comments just ignored it and it blew over most people dont look that closely and honestly a lot of real influencers are so edited they look ai generated anyway im not saying this is easy money because it definitely isnt the first 4 months were basically unpaid learning but for someone like me who genuinely cannot handle being on camera finding this path felt like finally finding a door that wasnt locked now working on a second account in a completely different niche to see if i can replicate it early days but the process is way faster now that i understand the workflow the 500month goal feels actually achievable by end of summer if the second account gets any traction at all

searching for the dead husband an accomplice but mistakes that aldo is out for a deadly revenge and will come for them next lou and aldo have to team up to face the mafia the mayor many assassins a lone cop a lot of misunderstandings and mayhem a taste for blood is a graphic novel by the swiss artist debuhme originally published in french europe comics published the english translation by dan christensen in 2022 the book blends action and violence with dark humor in a very short number of pages the book manages to cram in a lot of stuff like political intrigue crime murders betrayal the teaming up of contrasting characters sibling rivalry a romance thats not acknowledged domestic violence and even a cute dog even when it seems densely plotted the book gave me an empty feeling as the writer uses various themes listed above just to accelerate the plot without giving it any space to develop organically it just flits rapidly from one thing to the next creating in us a sense of pace the book overtly depends on the foibles of the characters to create an emotional impact and adds the dog as a manipulative device the last point worked though the best part of the book is its art which makes it palatable to a large extent debuhme uses a caricature style of characterization that resembles a cartoon rather than a typical graphic novel it exaggerates the actions and emotions of the characters and fills the frame with their oversized nature forcing the reader to engage more with them the color palette varies from scene to scene and manages to capture the atmospheric mood of different settings overall the art of this book is good to look at and works well to tie up the characters settings and their motives far better than the weak plot its length of around 120 pages ensures that the book doesnt overstay its welcome its nothing exceptional but a fastpaced violent crime thriller thats funny because the pictures are funny the plot just skims the surface of several interesting themes and never bothers to explore anything tangential but prefers to be limited and utilitarian that means anyone who looks for something deep and provides an insight into the characters
